key.name: update-interval
key.description: How often to update the battery levels (in minutes)

key.name: show-hover-percentage
key.description: When enabled, hovering over the panel icon shows the battery percentage. Ignored when "Always show percentage" is on. Disable to avoid layout shifts when multiple icons are in the panel.

key.name: always-show-percentage
key.description: When enabled, the battery percentage is always visible in the panel, without needing to hover.

key.name: hide-original-bluetooth-icon
key.description: When enabled, hides the built-in Bluetooth status icon so that only this extension's icon is shown.

key.name: device-overrides
key.description: Manual overrides: each entry is "Device Name|type" (e.g. "Tribit XSound Go|speaker"). Types: headphone, speaker, controller, mouse, keyboard, phone, tv, tablet, watch, car.

key.name: position-box
key.description: Which panel box to place the indicator in: left, center, or right.

key.name: position-index
key.description: Position index within the panel box. Use -1 for automatic placement.

key.name: show-advanced-settings
key.description: Whether to show advanced configuration options in preferences.

key.name: hpadding
key.description: Horizontal padding inside the battery indicator capsule.

key.name: outer-margin
key.description: Extra space around the battery indicator widget (0 = default, higher = more space).
